Red Hats say if the corrupt Department of Justice decides to prosecute the late Jeffrey Epstein’s pedophilic clients, it’ll have to wheelbarrow their corpses into a federal courtroom. According to a Red Hat source speaking for Col. Kurtz, the group’s inscrutable leader, the Hats are proactively eliminating Epstein’s cohorts as opportunities arise.

After outgoing Republican House Rep. Thomas Massie named 14 people he described as Jeffrey Epstein “co-conspirators” during a one-minute speech on the House floor on Monday, August 31, Col. Kurtz assembled a strike force of former military Special Operations personnel to travel to Cesena, Italy, and dispatch Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri, a Rome-born Consigliere and Cosa Nostra figure whose lineage is intertwined with organized crime. His name was among those Massie rattled off, and our source said Massie affirmed suspicions Red Hats had held since obtaining a million pages of redacted files from a Justice Department source over a year ago.

“Teodorani-Fabbri went to Epstein Island 12 times and Epstein’s Zorro Ranch in New Mexico six times. The files, which I hope everyone will eventually see, have text messages from him to Epstein saying he likes to tie up young girls at the ankles and take them from behind. And Epstein replying to him with messages like, and I’m paraphrasing now, “That’s all possible here and so much more than your wildest dreams. He was a fucking pedophile,” our source said.

Colonel Kurtz, he added, opted to have Teodorani-Fabbri whacked first because he deemed him a “hard target,” a foreign person living at a walled villa and with bodyguards shadowing his movements.

“If we could get to Italy, equip ourselves, and neutralize him, getting to other abusers would be a cakewalk,” our source said. “Hardest things first—that is Col. Kurtz’s motto.”

On September 1, nine unarmed Red Hats boarded a flight from JFK International Airport to Leonardo da Vinci International Airport and, upon landing, moved with alacrity to carry out their goal. Per our source, Red Hats had obtained credible intelligence that Teodorani-Fabbri would be at his family’s Cesena villa until at least September 5.

“A narrow window,” our source said. “But we had his place’s blueprints, a layout of the land, a timetable of his comings and goings, and, most importantly, a bit of help from a few people at one of Italy’s intelligence services.

Asked how exactly a decentralized group of rebels recruited a foreign service operative, he replied condescendingly, “I’ve told you before, haven’t I, we’re everyone, everywhere; the retired cop next door; the grocer at your corner store; the prior service sailor, soldier, or Marine down the street; the con who no one would give a second change; or, maybe, the former CIA agent who’s hard-wired and still has overseas connections. And, maybe, one pointed us at Teodorani-Fabbri.”

Colonel Kurtz, he emphasized, had reviewed the aging playboy’s dossier long before Thomas Massie called him out. The elusive Teodorani-Fabbri and Epstein were veritably inseparable from 2003 to 2018. After the State of Florida in 2008 convicted Epstein, who pleaded guilty to charges of solicitation of prostitution and procuring a person under 18 for prostitution and sentenced him to 18 months in the Palm Beach County Jail, Teodorani-Fabbri wrote to him often, reportedly pining for more trips on board the Lolita Express to Epstein Island. Before and after Epstein’s ridiculously brief incarceration—due to a plea deal—Teodorani-Fabbri accompanied Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell to New York, Rome, Paris, and the Caribbean. It’s documented that Teodorani-Fabbri referred to Epstein as “master.”

“We had to remove this mother fucker from circulation,” our source said.

Unfortunately, he wouldn’t share explicit details about how Red Hats “neutralized the pedophile,” only that they tailed him from his home to a nightclub and “took care of him and a bodyguard” after the intoxicated pair left the establishment.

Our source sent us a gruesome picture of a disemboweled man matching Teodorani-Fabbri’s likeness, lying prone and obviously dead on the south side of the Savio River. RRN has yet to authenticate the image, but it appears authentic.

“Systematically, we’ll get them,” our source said. “No one else cares, so it falls to us. None of those prolific pedo fuckers deserve to live.”
